name: Classic City Spooks 2017
information: The venue for the competition is different on each day of the competition. Please see the Venue tab for full details. * **Friday** and **Saturday** will be in the Fireside Lounge at **Rooker Hall.** * **Sunday** will be in the Ballroom at **Memorial Hall**. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue. There will be a costume contest on Sunday! Happy Halloween!
